$comment: The single source of truth for which backend responses we have actually observed.
Both scripts/record-contract.mjs and scripts/check-contract.mjs read this file,
and scripts/coverage.mjs diffs it against docs/api/swagger.snapshot.json to answer
'what do we not know yet?'. Adding an endpoint is an edit here, not to a script.
op       METHOD + path, exactly as keyed in the OpenAPI document.
sample   Query string used when recording. Prefer a large pageSize: nullable
fields only reveal themselves across a wide enough sample.
schema   Named export from lib/api/schemas/catalog.ts. Omit (null) when the
shape has been recorded but not yet modelled — coverage counts only
itemsAt  Dotted path to the array whose per-field nullability we summarise.
auth     true → recorded only when CONTRACT_TOKEN is set.
An invented schema is worse than none: it alarms on the truth. Leave schema null
until a real response has been observed.

endpoints.label: cart
endpoints.$why: Only ever observed empty, so the item shape is genuinely unknown. Modelling it now would be a guess.
